ecole.subtitle: Waggas School is the paragliding school of the Dune du Pilat.
ecole.p1: We accompany you in paragliding to fly over the Dune du Pilat. You can discover the Arcachon Basin and the Dune from the sky and admire this unique landscape with the sandbanks and oyster parks of the Arguin bank, Cap Ferret...
ecole.p2: Accompanied by a state-certified instructor, you can fly safely in wind conditions perfectly suited for paragliding.
ecole.p3: Takeoff and landing phases are gentle; you literally have nothing to do but let the instructor guide you.

tarifs_section.subtitle: All our packages

faq.a: No, booking is completely free. Payment is made on site on the day of the flight.

faq.q: Can we change the flight type on site?
faq.a: Yes! You are only committed to the duration (10 or 20 min). You can choose between 'discovery' or 'sensation' on the big day.
We accept Checks (with 2 IDs) and Cash. Please note: Credit cards and holiday vouchers are not accepted.

faq.q: What happens in case of bad weather?
faq.a: You will be informed the day before between 6pm and 8pm by email/SMS. If the flight is canceled, you can reschedule online.

faq.q: What is the age and weight limit?
faq.a: The activity is accessible from 5 to 99 years old, for a weight between 25 kg and 120 kg (depending on wind conditions).

faq.q: Is a specific physical condition required?
faq.a: No, it's accessible to everyone! Only contraindications: pregnant women, bone fragility, or hernia.

faq.q: Do you get vertigo in paragliding?
faq.a: Good news: you do not suffer from vertigo in paragliding! Vertigo disappears as soon as your feet no longer touch the ground.

faq.q: Do you offer a video option?
faq.a: It's free! You can bring your own smartphone or camera (remember to bring a selfie stick).

faq.q: Can we buy a gift voucher?
faq.a: Yes, the voucher can be downloaded for free on our site! Payment will only be made on the day of the flight to guarantee the service against the weather.

faq.q: Can we fly without an appointment?
faq.a: Bookings have priority. But if we have empty slots on site, it's possible!

faq.q: How to dress for the flight?
faq.a: Clothing instructions will be sent to you the day before by email with the weather confirmation.

faq.q: Do we say 'jump' or 'flight' in paragliding?
faq.a: We are talking about a FLIGHT! We take off gently on the dune, we do not jump into the void.

drawer_access.title: Getting to Waggas school
drawer_access.subtitle: By appointment
drawer_access.intro1: In the shade of the pines or under the gentle sun of the Dune du Pilat, you can fully enjoy the diversity this site offers.
drawer_access.intro2: A flat, shaded path ensures accessibility for all visitors.

car.title: By car
car.subtitle: Parking
car.parking_desc1: Park in the gravel parking lot
car.parking_desc2: 15 min walk to the Waggas School flags

foot.title: On foot
foot.subtitle: Walking route
foot.desc1: From the parking lot, follow the path towards the dune that runs alongside Pyla Camping (about 15 min).
foot.desc2: Take it to the dune – look for the Waggas School flags.

boat.title: By boat
boat.desc1: If you have your own boat, you can anchor at the foot of the Dune du Pilat on "Robinson" beach and join us on foot 50 meters higher at the flags.
boat.subtitle: Boat shuttles (UBA)
boat.desc2: You can also opt for the UBA shuttles.
boat.desc3: Summer shuttles are organized to take you to the foot of the Dune du Pyla "Robinson beach" departing from Arcachon, Le Moulleau (Pyla sur Mer), Cap Ferret…

bus.title: By bus
bus.desc1: Once you get off at the "Pyla Camping" stop, you can reach us by walking on the forest path located between Pyla Camping and Panorama Camping, to get to the takeoff site (10min).
bus.warning: As Pyla Camping is private property, crossing it is prohibited.
bus.arcachon_desc1: Take Line 3 and get off at the "Pyla Camping" stop.
bus.arcachon_desc2: Once you get off at the "Pyla Camping" stop, you can freely and cross Pyla Camping on foot for free to get to the takeoff site (10min).
bus.lateste_desc1: Shuttles are set up from the La Teste de Buch Exhibition Center to the Dune du Pyla. Take bus line 3 to the "Pyla Camping" stop.
bus.lateste_desc2: Join us at the campsite exit "beach access" (dune side).
bus.lateste_desc3: You will be able to identify us thanks to our Waggas School flags located 200m from the campsite, on the Dune du Pilat.
